patch_description: Replace the pure snake (serpentine) LPT heuristic in `balanced_packing` with a balanced-pair "greedy matching" variant, as recommended. Items are sorted descending, then the k-th heaviest item is matched with the k-th lightest item (pair id = min(pos, n-1-pos)). Pairs are then distributed to packs round-robin with alternating (snake) direction per pair block, and the rank within the pack records whether the item was the heavy or light member of its pair. This guarantees each pack receives one heavy and one light item per pair block (heavier improvement over the item-level snake, which can put two mid-heavy items in the same pack when groups_per_pack > 2), while keeping the construction fully tensorized and loop-free via `scatter_` on the sort indices. This targets improved GPU balancedness while preserving the vectorized speed of the current implementation.
